description: Exact effective formulas of the dark-sector analysis of dirac16complex (SPEC sections 8, 11) for the author's metric with b4(x4) (2026-10-14), derived by Revision/dark_sector/dirac16complex/derive/derive_effective.py (sympy); every entry is a named check of reports/derivation-checks.json.
coordinates: the author's coordinates {x0, ..., x7} (Dirac_Einstein-Lovelock_4+4_Nash.nb, In[48]): x0 = hidden direction, z = 6 H x0 in (0, pi/2), y = ln(sin z)/(6 H); x1, x2, x3 = 3-space (scale factor e^{a4} sin^{1/6} z); x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the three exponentially DEFLATING extra times (time-like, scale factor e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} sin^{1/6} z).
metric: diag(cot^2 z, e^{2 a4} sin^{1/3} z (x3), -1, -e^{-2 a4} b4 sin^{1/3} z (x3)) (the author's In[97]-In[102]); b4 = b4(x4) > 0, a function of x4 (the withdrawn record before 2026-10-14 used b4 = 1)
observerScaleFactor: a = e^{a4} (3-space scale factor on the brane z = pi/2, normalised a = 1 at the chosen 'today' a4 = a4_today, i.e. a = e^{a4 - a4_today}); b4 does not enter it
beta: beta = d ln b4/d a4 = b4'/(a4' b4) != 0 along a history (b4 is a function of x4, never 1); on a4 = H x4 with the author's weights and a diagonal source beta = 4/3, b4(x4) = b4(0) e^{(4/3) H x4}
withdrawnRecord: the record before 2026-10-14 used b4 = 1 (withdrawn); its formulas are the terms without beta

conservation.x0: d p0/d x0 + 3 H cot z (2 p0 - p3 - p_t) = 0  <=>  p0_y + 6 H p0 = 3 H (p3 + p_t)
conservation.integrated: dE/d a4 = -3 (P3 - Pt) - (3/2) beta Pt, E = int rho sqrt|g| d^7x, P3 = int p3 sqrt|g| d^7x, Pt = int p_t sqrt|g| d^7x (per unit coordinate volume; fixed occupations / exact solutions)

rho4.A_compact_coordinate_period: ASSUMPTION: the extra times are compact with a fixed coordinate period (closed time-like directions); rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.B_per_unit_extra_time_coordinate_volume: non-compact extra times; rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume x extra-time coordinate volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.C_per_unit_proper_7_volume: rho_4 = E/(proper 7-volume) x (constant) ~ E b4^{-3/2} (equivalently per unit proper extra-time volume e^{-3 a4} b4^{3/2})

wEff.definition: w_eff = -1 - (1/3) d ln rho_4/d ln a

ratios.wx0: P0/E (integrated; the x0 ratio, not the CPL w0); brane-local p3/rho etc. also reported

condensate.w_ratio: w_c = lambda S/(2 m + lambda S)

flatModeLabelled.status: flat (warp-free) limit, used for the sign structure and the limits only
flatModeLabelled.massive_w_eff_A: k^2/(3 (M^2 a^2 + k^2)) (q = 0: independent of b4)

mixtures.w_eff: sum_i X_i/sum_i E_i - s + (beta/2)(sum_i Pt_i/sum_i E_i + s)

cpl.convention: w(a) = w0 + wa (1 - a); thawing wa < 0, freezing wa > 0 (the formula decides)
cpl.tangent: w0 = w(1), wa = -dw/da at a = 1 = -dw/da4 at a4 = a4_today

expansionInferred.einsteinMixed: G^x4_x0 = (3/2) H cot z b4'/b4 = kappa T^x4_x0: with b4' != 0 Einstein gravity has no diagonal source

authorWeightsB4Branch.variables: alpha = a4'/H, beta = b4'/(H b4), p = a4''/H^2, q = b4''/(H^2 b4)
authorWeightsB4Branch.linearHistory: alpha = 1: beta_v in {0, 4/3}; alpha = -1: beta_v in {-4/3, 0}; d ln b4/d a4 in {0, 4/3}
authorWeightsB4Branch.status: allowed by the mixed equation of a diagonal source; the source the other equations require is not constructed (OPEN)
